title: Shake a toothpick dispenser
text: Shake a toothpick dispenser. A nice way to keep toothpicks somewhat more sanitary and easy to access. Top has a twist to open feature, hole that dispenses toothpicks and then you can twist closed again. They don't easily spill out if the holder is knocked over.  We use these at our seafood boils.  Easy to wipe off the holder.  The picks are fairly good quality and you can refill the holder.  I will keep buying these!

product_metadata.title: Goodcook Touch Shake-A-Pick Toothpick Dispenser, Small, White/Black
features: SHAKE-A-PICK DISPENSER WITH TOOTHPICKS: Includes one Shake-A-Pick dispenser and 200 bamboo toothpicks
CONVENIENT DISPENSING LID: Easy-to-use dispensing lid twists open to release one toothpick at a time and twists closed to keep them securely inside the container
INCLUDES 200 TOOTHPICKS: Included single-point toothpicks are great for use after meals or for serving appetizers, and their sturdy bamboo material prevents splintering or breaking
EASY TO REFILL: Transparent sides allow you to see inside of the holder, while the screw-on lid makes it easy to refill when you run out of toothpicks
Toothpicks with "shake-a-pick" dispenser approximately 200 fancy single-point toothpicks in a handy plastic shaker dispenser.
